fonts.display: 'PT Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Void Black
palette.role: Page canvas, deep background layer — the absolute floor of the surface stack

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Primary page background where pure black would be too harsh — the actual canvas color in the dominant layout

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Card surfaces, nav bar, raised panels — the dominant mid-neutral

palette.name: Onyx
palette.role: Subtle elevation layer between canvas and card

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Box-shadow depth, elevated surface tint — provides warmth on hover and focus

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Hairline borders on dense tables, row dividers

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted body text, helper copy, link underlines — the workhorse mid-gray

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: High-emphasis body text where pure white would vibrate against black

palette.name: Chalk
palette.role: Display text, primary headings, icon strokes — the only text color permitted above #e5e5e5

palette.name: Signal Lime
palette.role: Primary CTA fill, glowing borders, italic accent words in headlines — the single chromatic punctuation in an otherwise monochrome system; at 17.8:1 contrast against black it reads as emergency lighting

palette.name: Olive Depth
palette.role: Dark green stroke for SVG world-map art and shadow glows under signal-lime elements

palette.name: Moss Shadow
palette.role: Deepest green used only as decorative stroke in dotted-globe illustrations
